description: DRAFT GOLDEN — taper picked faces by an angle about a neutral plane (the molding/casting release; also tapered bosses/walls). The 40x40x20 box with all FOUR side faces (+X/-X/+Y/-Y) drafted INWARD by 5 deg about the XY base plane (neutral plane z=0, pull +Z) -> a truncated square pyramid (frustum): base 40x40 at z=0 UNCHANGED (it lies on the neutral plane), top shrunk to 36.50045.. x 36.50045.. at z=20. A three-feature TREE (sketch 40x40 -> extrude 20 -> draft{faces: 4 picked sides}) through the evaluate-tree path: planegcs solve -> profile face -> 20 mm prism -> resolve the four side-face SubshapeRefs against body.faces() (exactly one each, the SAME stage-1 planar-face signature shell/on_face use) -> OCCT BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle (pull = neutral.z_dir = +Z, +5 deg) -> GProp -> tessellation -> content-addressed GLB. Byte-determinism incl. interpreter restart proves the four FACE refs resolve the same across a fresh rebuild; the parametrized STEP round-trip re-imports the all-planar (slanted) frustum B-rep.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, cross-checked against the harness (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug). Base body is the 40x40x20 box (volume 32000 mm^3). Draft angle theta=5 deg, all four side faces tilted INWARD about the neutral plane at z=0, pull +Z.

SIGN reconciliation (measured 2026-07-13, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): build123d Solid.draft(faces, neutral_plane, angle) drives BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle with pull = neutral_plane.z_dir; a POSITIVE angle tapers the faces INWARD toward the pull (+Z) end (the top NARROWS) -- confirmed by measuring vol at +5 deg = 29282.0083 (< box) and at -5 deg = 34881.28 (> box). The base at z=0 lies ON the neutral plane so it stays 40x40; each side tilts by 5 deg from vertical, moving inward by h*tan(theta) at height h.

volume (pyramidal frustum, exact for a linear taper): V = h/3*(A_bottom + A_top + sqrt(A_bottom*A_top)) = 20/3*(1600 + 1332.2831027099267 + 1460.0181383585214) = 29282.008273789652 mm^3. (Equivalently the exact integral int_0^h (a-2*tan(theta)*z)^2 dz.) Harness (OCCT GProp) reproduces 29282.00827378966; deviation 7.3e-12 mm^3 (~2 ulp of 29282), pure float round-off between the tan-based analytic value and OCCT's Gauss-quadrature volume integral -- absorbed by the tolerance.

surface_area = bottom + top + 4 trapezoidal sides. bottom = 1600; top = 1332.2831027099267. each side face is a trapezoid with parallel edges a=40 (bottom) and top=36.50045345896304, and SLANT height = h/cos(theta) = 20/cos(5deg) = 20.076396750866948 (the face is tilted 5 deg off vertical); trapezoid area = (40+36.50045345896304)/2 * 20.076396750866948 = 767.9267276316868; four of them = 3071.706910526747. surface_area = 1600 + 1332.2831027099267 + 3071.706910526747 = 6003.990013236674 mm^2 (harness 6003.990013236675, deviation 9.1e-13).

centroid: two mirror symmetries survive (planes x=20 and y=20), so centroid.x = centroid.y = 20 EXACTLY. z = int_0^h z*(a-2*tan(theta)*z)^2 dz / V = 9.695243014314576 mm (float64; the harness reproduces 9.695243014314576, deviation 0.0). It sits below the mid-height 10 because the wider base carries more volume.

bounding_box = [0,0,0]..[40,40,20]: the base 40x40 is unchanged (on the neutral plane) and the top only shrinks INWARD, so the outer envelope is the base extent; height is untouched (the neutral plane is the base, the pull is +Z). Harness bbox min carries ~1e-16 float noise on x/y/z (absorbed by the tolerance), max exact.

topology: a frustum is topologically a box -- 6 faces (bottom + top + 4 slanted trapezoidal sides), 12 edges, 8 vertices, 1 shell, 1 solid. Draft does not split or merge faces (each of the 4 named faces is tilted in place, the 2 unnamed z-faces stay), so counts equal the base box's.

mesh (linear 0.1 mm / angular 0.1 rad, isRelative=False): every face is PLANAR (slanted but flat), so deflection does not subdivide any face. 6 quad faces * 4 nodes / 2 triangles each = 24 vertices and 12 triangles (per-face faceted normals, no vertex sharing across faces -- the same convention as the box / shell goldens).

GLB byte size is deliberately NOT pinned here: asserted deterministic (byte-identical) by the runner within one kernel version, but pinning the absolute size would break on glTF-writer upgrades without geometric meaning.
tolerance_rationale: SLANTED-PLANAR-geometry tolerance, measured then set (geometry-gates skill: never copy a bound blindly). Every face of the frustum is planar (slanted but flat), so the GProp integrals are exact-in-principle; the only residual is float round-off between the tan/cos-based analytic values and OCCT's BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle + GProp. Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-07-13, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, planegcs 0.8.0): volume 7.3e-12 mm^3 (~2 ulp of 29282), surface_area 9.1e-13 mm^2, centroid.x/y/z 0.0, AABB max exact, AABB min ~5e-16 float noise. Documented ceiling 1e-9 = ~130x the observed worst case (volume), matching the revolve-annulus / fillet-top-edge planar-and-curved posture with headroom for libm/platform variation across CI hosts. The solver contributes zero error by construction (zero-residual start, solved == input bitwise). Loosening this bound requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
